THE PROCESS

A clear path.
A little magic.

From our first conversation to your finished website, here is how we work together.

BRANDING / FIRST

I build websites. Branding comes first.

I do not offer branding services. You will need an existing brand identity and visual direction. If you need help with branding, I can introduce you to people who specialize in it. Let’s talk ↗

01

Discovery call

We talk about your goals, audience, current website and what the new site needs to do.

02

Your content & assets

You send your copy, logo, brand guidelines, images and other project assets. A defined branding direction is needed before the homepage exploration begins.

03

2 or 3 homepage drafts

I prepare two or three homepage drafts to explore visual directions. We choose a main direction and can bring in selected elements from the other drafts or your website references.

04

Homepage refinement

The selected homepage includes up to two rounds of revisions. We bring the feedback together to refine the direction before moving into the rest of the website.

UP TO 2 REVISION ROUNDS
05

Static pages

I build the agreed static pages using the approved direction. This stage includes up to two rounds of revisions for the full set of static pages, not two rounds for each page.

UP TO 2 REVISION ROUNDS
06

CMS pages, when needed

I build the agreed CMS collections and templates. The CMS stage includes up to two rounds of revisions for the complete CMS set.

UP TO 2 REVISION ROUNDS
07

Final checks & handover

We review the finished website, confirm the agreed scope and prepare for launch and handover.

What is a revision round?

One consolidated set of feedback on the current stage. New pages, a new scope or a change of direction after approval are discussed separately so the project stays clear for both of us.
